exposure: Indication for labor induction (e.g., overdue pregnancy, preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM), gestational diabetes, intrauterine growth retardation (IUGR), gestational hypertension, HELLP syndrome, pathological cardiotocograph (CTG), fetal anemia, placental insufficiency)
Compliance with 2020 German, Swiss and Austrian guideline program for labor induction
cohort: The study included 99 cases of singleton pregnancies undergoing labor induction at Klinikum Leer between June 2023 and November 2023.
finding: Labor induction following the 2020 German, Swiss, and Austrian guideline program was not associated with an increase in neonatal or maternal adverse outcomes, while indications not compliant with the guidelines showed an increased risk of neonatal acidemia.
mod_finding: A secondary cesarean section was performed in 31.31% of all induced labors, with rates of 33.30% for overdue pregnancies and 28.57% for PPROM.
gest_age: Variable (mean of 41+6.28 weeks for overdue pregnancy; included preterm cases for PPROM)
